status: Verified optional HTTP increment; complete standalone and production topology acceptance remain unfinished.

artifactProbe.output: Installed Common verified: explicit personal-http/notification-http, exclusive packages, exact derived public routes, domain-only closure without browser adapters, unchanged notification RPC owner, no HTTP schema ownership, unique classes and packaged SSE shutdown lifecycle.

verificationNotes: All six regression projects completed successfully in one final batch. Counts exclude the earlier focused run; no failed, errored or skipped tests.

Five new Common tests exercise actual selected HTTP packages, controller advice, method-security proxies, MVC prefix mounting, real SSE emitter, heartbeat scheduling and context shutdown with explicit domain mocks and absent Redis factory.
Every legacy personal/notification MVC method/path is compared to the modular mapping with exactly one /common prefix. Single-adapter and domain-only selections remain isolated.
Unauthorized personal read and unauthorized notification publish fail before domain mocks are called; permitted operations preserve IDs and reach the same domain services.

Packaged architecture validation covers domain-only ownership, three deployment-plan capability equivalence, explicit local notification-to-personal closure, 26 modules and 21 public contracts, actual H2 mappings and repository ownership. This is not three deployed services/topologies.

SSE shutdown test establishes a real MockMvc async stream, checks ready data, closes its context, observes async completion and removed scheduled tasks, then verifies rejection of post-close connections. No real Redis or network load test performed.
Dependency gate prevents domain runtime from carrying either optional REST artifact and prevents adapters from importing runnable hosts.
Common distribution was built separately with frontend packaging enabled; actual installed JAR probe and all manifest-declared JS/CSS assets passed. No new frontend source or typecheck claimed.
Existing deprecation warnings in other Common test fixtures and Gradle remain; all seven scoped Java files pass strict Checkstyle.
No business database or configuration mutations, deployment, commit or push.
limits: Notification still requires the personal domain locally. Making HTTP optional does not permit splitting that domain dependency across hosts.
Common retains its historical complete resource owner and legacy host bootstrap. Selected-module resource/scope catalogs, explicit owner adoption and full host initialization remain unfinished.

Redis Pub/Sub remains best-effort browser reconciliation hints, not durable cross-service events or operation completion. Runtime authentication/scope revalidation remains owned by domain/security components.
Full authentication, permission scope, database, RabbitMQ recovery, browser and multi-remote scenarios have not been executed in a formal standalone host.
Newest mandatory installation boundary requires replacing the preceding dictionary installation adapter implementation dependencies with pure ports. G11 records this outstanding correction.
Remaining HTTP/host adapters, installer credentials/policies/configuration/process readiness, one-JVM standalone and full three-topology business acceptance remain active work.
